body:
N-48 MEASUREMENT RESULT, 26 Nov 2026 (lead). MEASURED ONLY: no production code, no test, nothing deployed, nothing written to the library. Tool: handoff-2026-11-03/scripts/session-26nov/n48_measure.py (a = replay, b = live discography, report); data and the full report: local/n48-measure-26nov/ (held.json, disco.json, report_full.txt, the recorded answers). Live part: VM 108 (homelab log entries 11, 11b, 11c), 125 artists = every artist of the 176 songs (135 held + the 41 good stamps), 2,833 requests to Deezer in 14 min at the gate's 4/s (280 answers replayed), median 21 and mean 27 per artist (max 129), 0 errors; one release list cut at 200 (Snoop Dogg), two albums at the 100-track limit (RHCP, Rod Stewart).

(a) RECOVERY: the candidate rule (below) gives 74 of the 135 held songs a home: single_before_album 22 of 27, sole_album 41 of 49, date_decided 6 of 24, single_only 5 of 32 (the other 27: NO album, EP or compilation of that artist carries them), compilation_title 0 of 3. 65 name the album the matcher had already picked (the delay ends), 9 name another one (7 right as far as read: Hotel -> Split Personality, Break Stuff -> Significant Other, Misery Business -> Riot!, Reptilia -> Room on Fire, I Bet You Look Good -> Whatever People Say I Am, Turpentine This House, Grim Reaper -> Error 404). 18 of 24 date_decided stay ambiguous: a compilation with fresh ISRCs ('Papercuts') keeps In the End, Numb and Breaking the Habit held.

(b) SAFETY: labeled set of 11: 0 wrong, 5 right, 6 abstain; the 41 good stamps: 38 agree, 3 abstain, 0 contradict. TWO FLAWS THE MEASUREMENT FOUND IN THE RULE AS FIRST DRAWN: (1) My Chemical Romance 'Welcome to the Black Parade': the file is 314.7 s, the album's track 311.0 s (3.7 s apart, outside the 3 s tolerance), the 2014 compilation 'May Death Never Stop You' 314 s with a fresh ISRC: 'exactly one carrier' named the COMPILATION (the same wrong album as the 25 Nov stamp). Fix in the rule: the name is also asked at a loose 20 s and more than one family means abstain (then it abstains, correctly). (2) 'lowest share of tracks found elsewhere' (by_share) picked 'Bunch of Bettys' (2024) for Spiderbait 'Black Betty' (the matcher had Tonight Alright): 1 of 8 by_share answers probably wrong. So by_share is NOT safe alone; the CANDIDATE RULE is: one family carries the recording, or the shares AGREE with the matcher's own pick (72 of 135).
Fat Joe 'What's Luv?' abstains rightly: the file is the SINGLE edit (231 s, feat. Ashanti), the album track is 267 s with another guest: not the same recording at 36 s (the labeled 'album track left as a single' is a tolerance question, not a discography one).

(continued in the next note: cost, year, decisions)
